messages:
Jordan (customer): Hey team — after the deploy tonight our invoice bot started truncating line items when a trailing period is present. Worked before rollout. Anyone else seeing this?
eli: ugh, noted. Any error logs or request IDs?
Jordan (customer): No 500s, responses are valid but text ends mid-sentence. Example: sending prompt with template placeholder '{{items}}.' vs ' {{items}}' changes output. Super minor whitespace.
maria: can you paste the exact prompt and one of the model outputs? small snippets are helpful.
Jordan (customer): sure — prompt: ```Generate an itemized invoice for the following items:
{{items}}.
``` with items = "Widget A
Widget B" returns only "Widget A" now. If I remove the period after the placeholder it returns both.
ash_k: tagging eng-runtime. This smells like tokenization/terminator handling after the canary. We rolled quantized variants and a new tokenizer patch in canary earlier.
eli: also seeing a spike in tail latency for these calls in our logs around the same deploy window (p95 increased from 180ms -> 620ms for some routes). No 500s but a lot of partial outputs.
ops_bot: deploy-bot: canary 2026-03-16T22:40 completed on service inference-runtime v4.2.1-canary-3 
ash_k: Jordan — can you repro with curl and include headers (model and model-variant) so we know whether it hits the canary variant?
Jordan (customer): yup, here's a minimal repro curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-q4o", "variant":"canary-3", "input":"Generate an itemized invoice for the following items:\nWidget A\nWidget B\n{{END}}."}'
```
It returns only "Widget A" again. If I change the trailing `.` to `\n` it returns both lines.
maria: thanks. Repro is golden. Sounds like suffix/terminator token lost when punctuation follows cached KV? Could be prefix cache boundary bug introduced with the continuous-batching change.
eli: also got a billing flag from Jordan — token counts jumped 2x for same requests post-rollout. Likely because of unexpected tokenization differences. Jordan, did billed tokens increase?
Jordan (customer): yes, invoices show tokens doubled on that endpoint since deploy. Not huge $$ but definitely wrong.
ash_k: steps I'll take: 1) reproduce internally against canary-3, 2) diff tokenizer outputs for the two prompt variants, 3) check cache boundary handling in batcher code path that was modified in v4.2.1-canary-3. If confirmed, hotfix -> rollback.
maria: can we run a quick ablation to see if this is quantization-specific? Try model variant redwood-fp16 (non-quant) and redwood-q2a (older quant) and report. Jordan, could you run the curl with variant redwood-fp16?
Jordan (customer): running now... fp16 returns both items (good). q2a returns broken. So it seems tied to the new quant path.
eli: great signal. ops, any capacity to rollback canary-3 for that model variant while we investigate? We need to avoid more customer impact.
nash_k: I'll open a runtime bug (ENG-5231) and attach this thread + repro. If rollback is safe, prefer rollback for the quantized variant only. Also need to surface to billing team about tokenization delta.
maria: adding repro notes to the incident: - exact prompt - model variants tried - observed token counts - latency delta
ops_bot: incident-bot: Incident ENG-5231 created by ash_k, priority P2.
eli: @maria @ash_k can someone check logs for KV-cache hits around request_ids we get from Jordan? If caching incorrectly splits token boundaries it'll explain truncation.
maria: on it. I see a handful of requests from Jordan's org id with `prefix_cache_miss: true` and `cache_boundary_token: 50256` around the window. That token is a newline/terminator in the new tokenizer mapping.
nash_k: that aligns. Likely cache boundary token index changed with tokenizer tweak; when punctuation directly follows placeholder it maps to a different token so cache lookup fails mid-prefix and we drop suffix.
eli: next: schedule rollback of canary quant variant if low-risk, and patch batcher to handle boundary remapping during canary. Also QA to add prompt templates with trailing punctuation to prompt-suite.
Jordan (customer): thanks all. Appreciate fast response. Happy to test a canary rollback build if you want me to.
maria: we'll ping you with a rollback test build. tagging @billing-team for token-count delta.
nash_k: quick todo list in thread: 1) ENG-5231 created, 2) run ablation across quant variants (done by ash_k), 3) rollback quant canary or patch batcher, 4) update customer with ETA, 5) add regression test for trailing punctuation in templates.
eli: thanks. small template change causing big user impact — we'll prioritize. :thumbsup:
Jordan (customer): sounds good, will standby.
